# MCPB schema provenance

`mcpb-manifest-v0.3.schema.json` and `mcpb-LICENSE` are unmodified copies of
`schemas/mcpb-manifest-v0.3.schema.json` and `LICENSE` respectively from the
[MCPB repository](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/mcpb/tree/70fe3b34cd6dff1b3bba046638edc72a6467a4fb),
commit `70fe3b34cd6dff1b3bba046638edc72a6467a4fb`.

SHA-256:

- Schema: `3a0ac9d845711a1b9b17dfa5a52f8b60628239d6a86a9db417206a9efc78592d`
- License: `0382b0057770ca05e9c350a50aa3b1c1fea84da0bc81d723bf00b9aa841be58a`

The upstream LICENSE describes the transition from MIT to Apache-2.0; new
specification contributions use Apache-2.0 and contributions without
relicensing consent remain under MIT. Consult the copied notice for terms.

The packaging helper caps each universal executable or MCPB at 256 MiB and
individual document inputs at 16 MiB, with a cumulative MCPB limit of 256 MiB.
Larger legitimate releases require an explicit review of these limits.
